tells.1: Strings of clipped short sentences ('I straightened... I checked... I wiped') and a run-on opening fragment create a forced casualness. It reads like a humanizer pass rather than natural voice.

tells.5: 'I found myself doing the usual things:' followed by a gerund triad and a semicolon pairing is a stock AI reflective construction, and curly quotes suggest generated text.

reason: Version 3 is clean, direct and unforced, letting the details carry the emotion without stylistic flourishes. The others either over-polish with colon and semicolon structures and an aphoristic contrast, or overcorrect into choppy, artificially casual rhythm.
